visualCharacteristics.structure: pill anchor links + subheading + list + paragraphs

contentPattern: 1 row, 2 cells: [nav cell: one paragraph link per nav item, hrefs kept exactly (patient: #about, #take, #faq, copay PDF, #specialtypharmacy; HCP: #dosing, #admin, #faq-1, copay PDF, #specialty), rendered as a <nav> list of stacked outlined pills] | [text cell: h3 subheading (e.g. 'A generic equivalent to RAVICTI<sup>®*</sup>'), bold trademark paragraph, bullet list, h3 subheading, paragraphs]. The nav cell is detected as the cell containing only links. Decorative flower is CSS (hook: .columns-anchor-nav::after), not authored. Typically in a section with Style: light-green.
